readings.moment: Fräulein Lina came down into the kitchen
the temple struck eleven (Lina stayed until after this)
the kitchen clock showed thirteen minutes past eleven when the hall clock struck eleven

durations: a quarter of an hour (the kitchen clock is fast by this amount)
thirteen minutes (the piano played from 10:58 to 11:11 by the kitchen clock)
whereabouts: Rosa was in the kitchen at the back of the house during the evening
Rosa washed, dried, and polished the champagne glasses in the kitchen
Fräulein Lina came down into the kitchen at 10:47 by the kitchen clock
Fräulein Lina sat by the kitchen table
Lina stayed with Rosa in the kitchen until after the temple struck eleven
Rosa worked in the kitchen while Lina was there
Madame was playing the piano from 10:58 to 11:11 by the kitchen clock
Madame asked Rosa to fetch the master for the toast
Rosa went up the stairs, past the library, and up the last flight to the atelier
The master was on the floor by his bench in the atelier
Rosa knelt by the master in the atelier and called his name
Rosa went back down from the atelier
Rosa did not see Madame go up the stairs
Rosa did not hear Madame cry
